milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the acacia trapdoor (at spawn-relative [8, 1, 10] inside the shelter) and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is intentionally looking at the trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a white sheep (Color:0) produces 1-3 white_wool items that go directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wool, so having at least 1 white_wool confirms the sheep was successfully sheared with the shears from the chest.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta wool (1 white_wool + 1 magenta_dye at the crafting table) places the result directly in the player's inventory. The player starts with no magenta_wool, so having at least 1 confirms the crafting recipe was successfully completed.
